art.title: Christ in Limbo
art.why: The Harrowing of Hell: Christ with the banner of the cross steps on the broken door, a demon crushed beneath, and takes a captive by the wrist. Existing id, used only by the story bank.

art.title: Christ on the Cross [reverse]
art.why: Christ alone on the cross, haggard and bleeding: the one 'both God and man' of Anselm's argument. (The obverse has a donor; this side does not.)

art.title: The Crucifixion
art.why: A crucifixion with small groups on either side, the inscribed panel above Christ's head: the charge written over the condemned, for the courtroom picture. No Law-and-Gospel painting is in the NGA.
No Abraham and Isaac or Lamb of God.

art.title: The Crucifixion
art.why: Exactly the subject asked: Christ on the cross with an older woman to the left and a young man to the right, the Virgin and St John, in a round panel.

The Passion chorale, sung in every tradition: many pictures, one love.
